```text
  6. What is the intent of bluff-raising the river? How does
  this relate to thin value betting?



         Bluff-raises intend to take advantage of thin
         value bets on the river. If your opponents
                         SHOW ANSWER
         aren’t bluff-raising, you can do more thin
         value betting.
```

```text
  package on your own, a whole world will open up for
  your poker study. Follow along with this video to gain
  an understanding of how to make your own toy game
  solutions and learn how to explore how different
  opponent decisions impact different players.

  using the software and have a basic understanding of
  how GTO+ works and what the solutions it offers mean.
```

```text
45 ♠ GTO CRASH COURSE - STRATEGY GUIDE




    Exercise: Using GTO+

  For this exercise, build out the A-to-5 game with raises.
  Then lock in OOP so that the player always bets Tens
  plus. Now see how this changes the raising frequency of
  IP. Next, reset the locked nodes, and have IP always raise
  when bet into and see how that changes the optimal
  solution for OOP.
```

```text
46 ♠ GTO CRASH COURSE - STRATEGY GUIDE


    VIDEO 8


  GTO+ Strategy Building
  In this lesson, you will
  finally begin deploying        Coach:
  real poker solutions in        Ross Glover
  order to improve your
                                 Video Length:
  game. The video takes
                                 35:32
  you through creating
  a simulation using
  Ed Miller’s starting
  ranges and pits them against one another. You will see
  how an optimal player versus an optimal player will make
  decisions using these ranges on a K♥7♣2♦ board.

  After reviewing the optimal solutions, you will then learn
  how to take those solutions and put them into practice
  in a real poker situation. The idea is for you to learn how
  to build a default strategy for yourself that minimizes the
  possibility of you being exploited at the tables.

  In addition to strategy building, you will learn how to
  deploy GTO+’s database mode to make running solutions
  much more efficient. The video also details how to work
  with multiple bet sizing using the GTO+ Advanced Betting
  tab. And finally, you will learn how to utilize turn and river
  reports to get a bird's eye view of all possible decisions.

  Once you have completed this video, you should
  understand one approach to building a strategy using
  GTO+ that can be deployed in real game situations.
```

```text
47 ♠ GTO CRASH COURSE - STRATEGY GUIDE




    Exercises: GTO+ Strategy Building

  Using GTO+ build a strategy with the same ranges as
  in the video for the following flops – A♥7♣2♦, K♥Q♥T♥,
  Q♥J♣8♣, J♥T♣9♣, T♥8♣6♦, 7♥7♣2♦. When doing this
  exercise, initiate database mode and enter in all of those
  flops. At the end, you should have one GTO+ file that
  includes all of the above flops as part ofthe database.
```
